prefill.notFoundDescription: This instance has no template named "{{slug}}". It may be misspelled or missing from this version's catalogue.

banner.description: Pick from the catalogue, set a few values and the app runs on your own server.

class.host_network: Shares the host network, so its ports are not isolated.
class.devices: Passes a host device into the container.

grantReview.title: Review the access this app gets
grantReview.description: This template asks for more than a normal app. Each grant below is recorded in the audit log.
grantReview.rootOnly: Granting these needs the root ability and the matching capability switched on in runtime settings.

arch.title: No build for this CPU
arch.fix: Install on a node with a matching architecture, or pin another image tag. To try it under emulation, tick the box below and deploy again.

kernel.title: Kernel module missing
kernel.fix: Run modprobe {{module}} on the host, make it load at boot, then deploy again.

platform.title: This host cannot run it
platform.fix: Fix the cause above on the node, or install on a node that meets it.

root.title: Needs the root ability
root.fix: Ask an operator with the root ability to install this template, after enabling its capability in runtime settings.

compat.noArm64Hint: The registry has no arm64 build of this template.
